methods.label: Find the distance per centimeter
methods.explanation:
First find what one centimeter represents. Since \(12\) centimeters represents \(72\) kilometers, each centimeter represents \(72\div12=6\) kilometers. Therefore \(17\) centimeters represents
\[
17\cdot6=\boxed{102\text{ kilometers}},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
